shell.title: One account for the whole career journey.
shell.body: Connect your profile, CVs, jobs, events, employers, and AI recommendations in a secure, personalized workspace.
shell.secureBody: HttpOnly refresh tokens, email verification, TOTP, and security logs.

auth.passwordHelp: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a number.
auth.totpSubtitle: Open your authenticator app and enter the 6-digit code to finish signing in.
auth.totpHelp: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.totpInvalid: That code is incorrect or has expired. Try again.
auth.chooseIdentity: This email is linked to more than one profile. Choose how to continue:
auth.acceptTermsLabel: I agree to the Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.
auth.verifySentBody: We sent a verification link to {email}. Open it to activate your account.
auth.verifiedBody: Your email is confirmed. You can now log in.
auth.verifyNeedLinkBody: This page needs a valid verification link. Open the link from your email, or request a new one.
auth.verifyResentBody: A new verification email is on its way.
auth.verifyResendPrompt: Didn't get it? We can resend the link to {email}.
auth.verifyNoEmailHint: Open the verification link from your inbox to continue.
auth.verifyOtpSubtitleNoEmail: Enter the verification code from your email.
auth.verifyOtpResent: A new verification code has been sent. Please check your email.
auth.verifyLinkInvalid: This link is invalid or has expired.
auth.verifyUseLink: Verify automatically with the link in your email →
auth.verifiedOnboardingBody: Your email address has been verified. Let's finish setting up your profile.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your email and we'll send a reset link.
auth.forgotSentBody: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
auth.forgotOtpSubtitle: Enter the 6-digit code sent to {email}, or open the reset link in your email.
auth.forgotResent: A new code has been sent. Please check your email.
auth.resetSubtitle: Choose a strong password you don't use elsewhere.
auth.resetInvalidBody: This reset link is no longer valid. Request a new one to continue.
auth.resetDoneBody: Your password has been changed. Please log in with your new password.

validation.passwordMin: Password must be at least 8 characters.
validation.passwordComplexity: Include at least one letter and one number.
validation.nameMin: Name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.acceptTerms: Please accept the terms to continue.

apiErrors.emailNotVerified: Please verify your email before logging in.
apiErrors.accountLocked: Too many attempts. Your account is temporarily locked — try again later.
apiErrors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Try logging in instead.
apiErrors.resendCooldown: Please wait {seconds}s before requesting another email.

oauth.failedBody: We couldn't complete sign-in. Please try again.
oauth.missingTicket: This sign-in link is missing or no longer valid.
oauth.linkConflictSubtitle: An account already exists for {email}. Enter its password to link your social sign-in to it.
oauth.linkConflictInvalidPassword: Incorrect password. Try again, or reset your password instead.

partnerReg.title: Register as an employer
partnerReg.subtitle: Submit your company for review by the VinUni Career Center.
partnerReg.privacyNote: We use these details only to review your application and contact you. They are not shared publicly until your account is approved.
partnerReg.successBody: Thanks! We've recorded your request and sent a confirmation to {email}.
partnerReg.step1: The Career Center reviews your company details.
partnerReg.step2: Once approved, the contact receives an email to set a password and activate the admin account.
partnerReg.step3: Sign in to post jobs, manage your team, and reach students.
partnerReg.duplicateError: A registration or account already exists for this company or email. If you've applied before, please wait for review or log in instead.

validation.companyNameMin: Company name must be at least 2 characters.
validation.contactNameMin: Contact name must be at least 2 characters.

activate.title: Activate your account
activate.subtitle: Set a password to finish setting up your employer admin account.
activate.doneBody: Your password is set and your email is verified. You can now log in.
activate.invalidBody: This activation link is no longer valid. Please contact the Career Center or request a new invitation.

inviteAccept.title: Join this organization
inviteAccept.body: You're signed in as {email}. Accept to join the organization and start collaborating.
inviteAccept.loginBody: Please sign in to accept this invitation. We'll bring you right back here.
inviteAccept.doneBody: You've joined the organization and switched to it. Open your workspace to get started.
inviteAccept.invalidBody: This invitation link is missing or malformed. Ask your admin to resend it.
inviteAccept.alreadyMember: You're already a member of this organization.
inviteAccept.emailMismatch: This invitation was sent to a different email address. Sign in with the invited account to accept.
inviteAccept.expired: This invitation has expired. Ask your admin to send a new one.
inviteAccept.used: This invitation has already been used.
inviteAccept.invalid: This invitation is no longer valid. Ask your admin to resend it.
